note: Personal detail values a fixture or seed may carry. The test data rule (Clemenza, 2026-09-20) protects real minors; every person in the fixture is synthetic, so the rule is not 'no such field' but 'no value outside this set'. qa/check.js fails the lint stage on a date_of_birth, age, contact detail, photo or school name on an athlete, course, contact or metric row whose value is not listed here. Every entry carries a reason and the date it was added, same discipline as boot-allowlist.json. What this cannot do is tell an invented value from a real one that somebody added here; the only guard against that is the rule that no fixture value is ever copied from the production database, which nothing here enforces (qa/GAPS.md).
